newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed mixed against hard currencies after a rather dull Wednesday interbank session, foreign exchange dealers said.
"It was a very quiet day with only a bit of two-way trading. We had a few tobacco inflows but too little to really move the Zimbabwe dollar," commented one dealer.

The local unit finished the day at 11.3100/3200 against the U.S. dollar, where it was fixed the whole day and where it also closed on Tuesday, but was quoted weaker on sterling at 18.5210/5430 compared to 18.5130/5430, following a softening of the U.S. dollar on that currency overseas.
It was at 6.5515/5590 from 6.5225/5310 against the mark but firmed on the rand to 2.5030/5075 from 2.5070/5110.
